text:
So you think that you can start collecting
Wishing Stars now and get in the chairman’s favor?\c
That’s the way of things, is it?
I see. So you do have some cunning in you.[VAR 0114(000C)]
But I won’t have it!\nI won’t allow anyone to stand in my way![VAR 0114(000C)]
But why...? How can this be?\nHow could someone like you get in my way?[VAR 0114(000C)]
